blocks.text: The enclosure is opened and Banda is said to escape toward Jammu, where he lives quietly for a time and gathers followers through signs, blessings, and fulfilled assurances.
The narrative then bends into another tradition entirely, moving from survival legend toward marriage and lineage.
Jammu anchors the page because it becomes the place of Banda’s hidden continuation after apparent destruction.
